DHAKA, Sept 14, 2022 (BSS) - Finance Minister AHM Mustafa Kamal today said that the government is considering introducing the market-based foreign currency exchange rates in the country.

"We're thinking of going for market-based foreign currency exchange rates," he said.

The Finance Minister was responding to queries of reporters after chairing virtually two separate meetings on the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) and the Cabinet Committee on Government Purchase (CCGP) today.
